label: VERIFIED
extraction: Curated collection of papers and resources on LLM agent orchestration, routing, scheduling, tool use, and multi-agent workflows. Key 2026 papers: 1) Learning to Orchestrate Agents in Natural Language with the Conductor (ICLR 2026) - RL-trained natural-language conductor for topology and prompt orchestration, 2) MAS-Orchestra (ICML 2026) - holistic multi-agent orchestration as function-calling RL, 3) ProgRouter (EMNLP 2026 Findings), 4) ACE-Router (ACL 2026) - history-aware routing from MCP tools to open Agent Web, 5) EvoRoute (ACL 2026) - experience-driven self-routing for cost-latency-quality tradeoffs, 6) Learning What to Retain (EMNLP 2026) - gated-memory routing for efficient collaboration, 7) Budget-Aware Tool Use (COLM 2026), 8) MCP-Bench (ICLR 2026), 9) SwarmBench (EMNLP 2026 Findings) - evaluation suite for dynamically orchestrated agent swarms. Also surveys: The Orchestration of Multi-Agent Systems (arXiv 2026).
